ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio (approximately 3:1) between high-intensity white/light-gray lobe surfaces and low-intensity black pigment in the central notch and peduncle regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions on the lateral lobes; central dark chevron-shaped region originating from the base; transition zones exhibit high-frequency black stippling/mottling along the interior edges of the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 40-45 degrees relative to the lobe centerlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (1-5 pixels) interrupted by occasional larger notches; significant jaggedness at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Predominantly convex curve originating from the median notch, transitioning to a sharp posterior taper at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete clusters of high-intensity white pixels (barnacle colonies) concentrated at the lateral tips and sporadically along the trailing edge serrations; smaller white spots visible on the black central chevron.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) on the white ventral surface, including a prominent diagonal line on the left lobe and several shorter vertical/diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized calcified clusters at the distal tips; multiple parallel and unaligned linear rake marks consistent with external friction or predatory interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive yellow-brown low-intensity staining (biofilm) located mid-lobe on the left side, contrasting with the primary white pigmentation.
